meaning.en: To say goodbye with tears in one's eyes.
meaning.zh: 含着眼泪告别，形容离别时十分伤感。

examples.zh: 战士们挥泪而别，踏上了远行的列车。
examples.en: The soldiers parted in tears and boarded the long-distance train.

examples.zh: 毕业那天，同学们挥泪而别。
examples.en: On graduation day the classmates said a tearful goodbye.

examples.zh: 她挥泪而别，一步一回头地离开了家乡。
examples.en: She left her hometown in tears, looking back at every step.

usage.en: Used as predicate, mostly in written narrative; emotional register.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于叙事文字，感情色彩浓。

literal: on the point of · parting · give · words

meaning.en: Words of advice or encouragement given to someone who is about to leave.
meaning.zh: 分别时送给对方的勉励或忠告的话。

examples.zh: 老师的临别赠言，我一直记在心里。
examples.en: I have always kept my teacher's parting words in mind.

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长给同学们写下临别赠言。
examples.en: At the graduation ceremony the headmaster wrote farewell advice for the students.

examples.zh: 他留下一句临别赠言：做人要诚实。
examples.en: He left one parting piece of advice: be honest.

usage.en: A noun phrase; often used for teachers, elders or friends leaving, or in graduation writing.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，多用于师长、朋友分别或毕业留言。

pinyin: sòng jūn qiān lǐ, zhōng xū yī bié
literal: see off · you · a thousand · li, in the end · must · one · parting
natural: however far you see me off, we must part in the end

meaning.en: However far you accompany someone, in the end you still have to say goodbye.
meaning.zh: 无论送多远，最终还是要分别。

equivalents: all good things must come to an end
there is no use prolonging a goodbye

examples.zh: 送君千里，终须一别，你们回去吧。
examples.en: However far you see me off we must part in the end; please turn back now.

examples.zh: 送君千里，终须一别，他挥挥手，转身上了车。
examples.en: 'Parting is inevitable, however far you go,' he said, waved and got on the bus.

examples.zh: 送君千里，终须一别，不如就在这里道别吧。
examples.en: We have to part sooner or later, so let's say goodbye here.

usage.en: Said by the host to end a long see-off, or by the leaver to ask others to turn back. Gentle, a little wistful.
usage.zh: 送行者或远行者用来结束送别，劝对方留步；语气温和，略带感伤。

pinyin: xiāng jiàn shí nán bié yì nán
literal: meet · time · hard · part · also · hard
natural: it is hard to meet and just as hard to part

meaning.en: It is hard to meet, and parting is no easier.
meaning.zh: 相聚不易，分别时也难舍难分。

equivalents: hard to meet, harder to part

examples.zh: 相见时难别亦难，他握着朋友的手，迟迟不愿松开。
examples.en: 'Meeting is hard and parting no easier'; he held his friend's hand and would not let go.

examples.zh: 车站里人们依依不舍，真是相见时难别亦难。
examples.en: At the station everyone lingered; truly it is hard to meet and hard to part.

examples.zh: 异地恋的人最懂什么叫相见时难别亦难。
examples.en: Those in long-distance relationships know best that it is hard to meet and hard to part.

story.en: The opening line of Li Shangyin's poem 'Untitled': 'Meeting is hard and parting is hard too; the east wind is feeble, a hundred flowers wither', about lingering love and the pain of parting.
story.zh: 李商隐《无题》首句：“相见时难别亦难，东风无力百花残。”写爱情中相聚不易、别离难舍的伤感。

usage.en: Quoted for lovers, relatives or friends who rarely meet; literary, common in essays and captions.
usage.zh: 多用于恋人、亲友难得相聚又难舍分离的场合；书面语，常见于作文、文案。

pinyin: qīng shān bù gǎi, lǜ shuǐ cháng liú
literal: green · mountains · not · change, green · waters · long · flow
natural: the green hills do not change and the water flows on

meaning.en: Said at parting or in hard times: some day we will meet again, so let us keep going.
meaning.zh: 青山永远不变，绿水长流不断；多用来在分别或逆境时表示后会有期、来日方长。

equivalents: the hills remain, the rivers flow on

examples.zh: 青山不改，绿水长流，咱们后会有期！
examples.en: The hills stay green and the rivers flow; we will meet again!

examples.zh: 这次输了不要紧，青山不改，绿水长流，下次再来。
examples.en: It doesn't matter that we lost; there will be another time.

examples.zh: 青山不改，绿水长流，各位保重，告辞了。
examples.en: The mountains stand and the waters flow; take care, everyone, and farewell.

usage.en: A parting formula, especially in martial-arts and historical fiction; also used to show confidence after a setback. Often followed by 后会有期.
usage.zh: 常用于告别，尤其在武侠、历史小说中；也用于表示遭遇挫折后不气馁。后面常接“后会有期”。

meaning.en: Even people who part will meet again someday.
meaning.zh: 山水尚有汇合之时，比喻分别的人总会有再见面的时候。

examples.zh: 今天一别，山水有相逢，我们后会有期。
examples.en: We part today, but hills and rivers do meet; until we meet again.

examples.zh: 山水有相逢，别难过，我们很快就能再见。
examples.en: Don't be sad, we will see each other again soon.

examples.zh: 山水有相逢，希望下次见面时你已功成名就。
examples.en: Paths will cross again; I hope you will be a success by then.

usage.en: Parting formula, often paired with 后会有期 or 青山不改，绿水长流. Casual or neutral.
usage.zh: 告别用语，常与“后会有期”或“青山不改，绿水长流”连用。口语或一般语体。

natural: the Yangguan Song in three refrains

meaning.en: The famous farewell song set to Wang Wei's poem about Yangguan Pass, sung with three repeats; a symbol of parting.
meaning.zh: 古代送别名曲，据王维《送元二使安西》谱成，反复吟唱三遍，后用来指离别之歌。

examples.zh: 古琴曲《阳关三叠》，唱尽了送别的深情。
examples.en: The guqin piece 'Yangguan Sandie' sings the full feeling of parting.

examples.zh: 他在毕业晚会上弹起《阳关三叠》。
examples.en: At the graduation party he played 'Yangguan Sandie'.

examples.zh: 一曲阳关三叠，听得满座皆泣。
examples.en: One rendition of Yangguan Sandie brought the whole room to tears.

story.en: Wang Wei's quatrain 'Seeing Yuan Er Off to Anxi' ('Weicheng morning rain...') was set to music as the Yangguan Song, whose melody repeats three times.
story.zh: 王维《送元二使安西》（“渭城朝雨浥轻尘”）被谱成《阳关曲》，旋律反复三叠，故称“阳关三叠”。

usage.en: Mostly a title of the guqin tune; used figuratively for a farewell song or scene. Literary.
usage.zh: 多指古琴曲名，借指送别的歌曲或场面。书面语。

natural: three looks back at every step

meaning.en: To leave very reluctantly, looking back again and again.
meaning.zh: 每走一步都要回头看几次，形容舍不得离开。

examples.zh: 孩子上学时一步三回头，舍不得离开妈妈。
examples.en: The child looked back at every step on the way to school, reluctant to leave his mother.

examples.zh: 他一步三回头地走出了村口。
examples.en: He walked out of the village looking back at every step.

examples.zh: 看着一步三回头的女儿，她心都碎了。
examples.en: Watching her daughter look back at every step, her heart broke.

usage.en: Describes reluctant leaving; casual, vivid, can also describe hesitating before something unwelcome.
usage.zh: 形容依依不舍的离去；口语，形象，也可形容对不愿做的事犹豫不决。

meaning.en: To turn and look back again and again while leaving.
meaning.zh: 离开时一次又一次回头张望，表示留恋。

examples.zh: 列车缓缓开动，她频频回首，直到看不见站台。
examples.en: As the train slowly pulled out she kept looking back until the platform was out of sight.

examples.zh: 他频频回首，望着渐渐远去的故乡。
examples.en: He kept looking back at his receding hometown.

examples.zh: 游客们频频回首，不舍得离开这片美景。
examples.en: The tourists kept looking back, unwilling to leave the beautiful scene.

usage.en: Predicate; literary, often paired with 频频挥手. Also used for looking back on the past.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面色彩，常与“频频挥手”连用；也可指回顾往事。

meaning.en: To wave over and over again, usually to say goodbye or greet.
meaning.zh: 一次又一次地挥手，多用于告别或致意。

examples.zh: 车开了，他还在窗口频频挥手。
examples.en: The bus pulled away and he was still waving from the window.

examples.zh: 运动员向观众频频挥手致意。
examples.en: The athletes waved repeatedly to the crowd.

examples.zh: 孩子们站在路边频频挥手，欢送远行的老师。
examples.en: The children stood by the road waving again and again to send off their teacher.

usage.en: Predicate; neutral, common in news and narrative.
usage.zh: 作谓语，中性，常见于新闻和叙事。

equivalents: years have passed since we parted

examples.zh: 一别经年，故人风采依旧。
examples.en: Years have passed since we parted, and my old friend looks just the same.

examples.zh: 一别经年，没想到我们会在这里重逢。
examples.en: After years apart, I never thought we would meet again here.

examples.zh: 一别经年，他的头发已经花白。
examples.en: Years after we parted, his hair has gone grey.

usage.en: Literary opening for letters or reunion scenes.
usage.zh: 书面语，常作书信或重逢场景的开头。

meaning.en: To meet again after a period of separation.

examples.zh: 别后重逢，大家都有说不完的话。
examples.en: Meeting again after our parting, we all had endless things to say.

examples.zh: 老同学别后重逢，激动得热泪盈眶。
examples.en: The old classmates were moved to tears on meeting again.

examples.zh: 别后重逢，他们都已两鬓斑白。
examples.en: When they met again after parting, both had greying temples.

usage.en: Similar to 久别重逢 but stresses the parting before the reunion; neutral to literary.
usage.zh: 与“久别重逢”相近，更强调先有分别再相见；中性偏书面。

natural: a short parting beats the honeymoon

meaning.en: A short separation makes a couple's reunion as sweet as being newly wed.
meaning.zh: 夫妻短暂分别后重聚，感情比新婚时还要甜蜜。

equivalents: absence makes the heart grow fonder

examples.zh: 他出差一周回来，夫妻俩小别胜新婚。
examples.en: He came back after a week away, and the couple was as happy as newly-weds.

examples.zh: 人们常说小别胜新婚，适当的距离有助于感情。
examples.en: People say a short parting beats a honeymoon; a little distance helps a marriage.

examples.zh: 她笑着说：小别胜新婚，我都想你了。
examples.en: She said with a smile: a short parting is better than a honeymoon, I've missed you.

usage.en: Light-hearted, mostly about couples; humorous in tone.
usage.zh: 语气轻松，多指夫妻，带幽默色彩。
